tier: EXACT-tier follow-through (refinement arm), as the parent T10a-R: every row is PASS or GATE FAIL against a prediction registered here; the reference is the sigma_OF exact enclosure flux of T10a; grades nothing against T10a's band
prior_arm: T10a-R (R_x fourth level at 2AI; R_q distTol 80 at the f mesh only; R_s solver bundle). T10aR2 repeats none of them.
directive: Sanaa H-3(a): T10a follow-through - the ceiling miss gets a refinement arm (discretization finding, cheap).
question: With the view-factor generator on the 2LI contour integration at EVERY level (distTol 80, the R-q knob), is the c/m/f mesh ladder for the B1 ceiling flux CONVERGING, and does the remaining miss at f (0.07857 % measured on R_q) shrink with the mesh at the same first-order-like rate the 2AI ladder showed (level-error ratios 1.66 / 1.50)? The number: the level-error ratios |e_c|/|e_m| and |e_m|/|e_f| of the 2LI ladder, and the 2LI GCI band at f divided into the 0.07857 % miss.
scope: the BOX only (1 x 1 x 0.5 m, six black patches). No spheres (H-3(b)). Grades NOTHING against T10a's band; T10a and T10a-R are closed and unchanged.

roache_floors.source: scripts/roache_triple.py, imported by name (MESH_STANDARD.md section 10.5, chief ruling 01967a7b); the comparator REFUSES if these numbers differ from the import, and DRIVES the frozen analyse_t1c.gci at p = 0.49 / 0.51 to show its own floor is the same 0.5
roache_floors.ground: STAGNANT_FLOOR 0.5 = p_expected/3 with p_expected = 1.48 (RR2 point, the parent 2AI ladder order) at r = 1.6 (0.493, taken as the family value 0.5): below it adjacent-level errors differ by < 1.6^0.5 = 1.26x, the levels-too-close-to-resolve-an-order state; the frozen analyse_t1c.gci the parent used already carries this floor as its STAGNANT branch (p < 0.5), so the parent T10a-R semantics are unchanged (its RX2 p = 0.685 was CONVERGING and stays so). P_MIN 0.05 is the degenerate floor (|p| < 0.05: e21 ~ e32). Both states are NOT A RESULT; the floors can only move a row INTO NOT A RESULT.

branches_registered_before_the_run.H1: the 2AI->2LI move is mesh-independent in W/m2 (+1.504 at every level): 2LI errors -8.628 / -4.583 / -2.566, ratios 1.883 / 1.786, p 1.4805, band 0.07673 %, dev/band 1.024
branches_registered_before_the_run.H2: the 2AI->2LI move scales with the level error (x0.630 at every level): 2LI errors -6.385 / -3.836 / -2.566, ratios 1.664 / 1.495, p 1.482, band 0.0482 %, dev/band 1.63
branches_registered_before_the_run.registered_point: H1; the intervals below contain H1 and exclude H2 on RR4, RR5 and RR6, so the measurement discriminates them and either outcome is reportable

RR1.quantity: IDENTITY (Charter 2a): max |qr(R2_f) - qr(R_q)| over every radiating face, W/m2
RR1.precondition: sha256(R2_f/constant/F) == sha256(T10aR_runs/R_q/constant/F) == 801700cf...; if the generator is not deterministic the row is NOT A RESULT and the non-determinism reported
RR1.falsifier: any nonzero difference given the precondition

RR2.quantity: observed p of the 2LI c/m/f triple for B1
RR2.falsifier: p outside [1.0, 2.0]; a non-CONVERGING triple is NOT A RESULT, no verdict

RR3.quantity: B1 deviation from exact at the 2LI f level, per cent
RR3.falsifier: outside the interval (given RR1 this is the R_q number; the row states the headline number, it does not test the physics)

RR5.quantity: dev / GCI band at the 2LI f level for B1
RR5.falsifier: > 1.30 (H2: the band-smaller-than-error pattern persists at the 2AI strength) or < 0.85 (the band covers the error, as at T10a-R's fourth level)

RR6a.quantity: 2AI->2LI move of B1 at level c, W/m2 (R2_c vs frozen B_c)

RR6b.quantity: 2AI->2LI move of B1 at level m, W/m2 (R2_m vs frozen B_m)

RR7.quantity: raw row-sum max defect of the written 2LI F, ratio level f / level c
RR7.falsifier: outside [0.7, 1.3] (the defect DOES move with the mesh under 2LI)

reported_not_graded: B0, B2, B3 under the same 2LI ladder: triple state, p, band, dev/band, sign-corrected Richardson
closure_raw and |c_raw - c_F| per case (T10a guard 1e-2, VOID withdraws the case's rows)
row-sum defect per patch per level
Richardson corrected and shared forms side by side, graded on neither
convergence: T10a section 5.5 rule via the frozen iterative_convergence: qr identical value for value between the last two written checkpoints (15 and 20); planted 1.234e-03 W/m2 recovered exactly as fl(old+plant)-old through the same reader on a scratch copy; an unconverged level -> refusal, no triple formed (D440)
